options.content:
**Scope & caveats:**

- **All AI figures on this dashboard are Claude Code OTel-only** (`provider = 'claude'` with `record_kind = 'canonical_activity'`) and scoped to the Project and Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping, so mixing them in made the “Company-wide” figures uncomparable to the project-scoped delivery panels below.
- **Active Hours** is queried directly from Claude Code's OTel telemetry, not the shared `ai_activities` table — session duration isn't rolled up into the domain layer for any provider.
- **Commits/lines never merged are inflated by squash-merge workflows.** A squash-merged PR keeps only its final squashed commit in the ingested history — the original branch commits never show up as “merged” even though the code did ship. Read this row as an upper bound on abandoned work, not an exact measurement.
- **PR Abandonment Rate** is the delivery-outcome view of the same problem: no field links an AI session to the branch or PR it produced, so a dollar/token cost can't be attached to abandoned work directly. This table measures it a different way instead — PR-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored) — as an outcome-based proxy for wasted effort, not an AI-cost-denominated one.

panels.description: Total AI tokens consumed, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_model_usages.*_tokens)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens Burned"
FROM ai_model_usages
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
)
AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Tokens Burned

panels.description: Total Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.num_sessions)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(num_sessions) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Claude Sessions

panels.description: Total active engineering hours logged by Claude Code, from OTel telemetry, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Not available at the domain layer for any provider.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ha.active_time_seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Active Hours"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity ha
WHERE ha.connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
)
AND $__timeFilter(ha.hour_start)

panels.title: Active Hours

panels.title: AI Lines Removed

panels.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)

panels.title: PRs Merged

panels.description: Pull requests closed without ever merging, scoped to the selected project(s).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Closed, Never Merged"
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'CLOSED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date)

panels.title: PRs Closed, Never Merged

panels.description: Commits with no record of ever landing in a merged pull request, scoped to the selected project(s). Inflated by squash-merge workflows — see the caveat above; read as an upper bound, not an exact count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha) AS "Commits Never Merged"
FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rc.repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
LEFT JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = c.sha
LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.id IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.committed_date)

panels.title: Commits Never Merged

panels.description: Additions + deletions summed over the same never-merged commit set above. Inflated by squash-merge workflows for the same reason — read as an upper bound, not a precise figure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(sz) AS "Lines Never Merged" FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, (c.additions + c.deletions) AS sz
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rc.repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  LEFT JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = c.sha
  LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.id IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.committed_date)
) x

panels.title: Lines Never Merged

panels.description: PR-level, not commit/branch-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored), scoped to the selected project(s), minimum 5 PRs authored in range to avoid noisy small-sample rates. Measures delivery outcome, not AI-specific cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name) AS "Contributor",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total PRs",
  SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') AS "Abandoned (Closed, Never Merged)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Abandonment Rate %"
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED') AND COALESCE(pr.merged_date, pr.closed_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: PR Abandonment Rate by Contributor

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$'
ORDER BY c.team_slug;
